title: Pro Shop Store Credit: membership gating for the VIP and Auto-Reload Premium tiers
content:
## Basis
Within the Pro Shop Store Credit product line, the VIP Credit $500 Tier and Auto-Reload Premium may each be opened only by a member whose club membership is currently active and whose membership tier-ladder rank is at least that tier's own minimum required rank. A member whose club membership sits below the required rank, or is not active, must first raise or restore that separately-held club membership before either of these two store-credit tiers may be opened for them.

## Evidentiary basis
Whether the member's club membership is active, and what rank it holds, is drawn from the member's own club membership record, correlated to the member opening the store-credit account. A member's own statement about their membership standing does not itself satisfy this condition; the club membership record is what this policy reads.

## Restated
| Club membership status | Membership tier-ladder rank | VIP Credit $500 Tier or Auto-Reload Premium openable |
|---|---|---|
| Active | At or above that tier's minimum required rank | Yes |
| Active | Below that tier's minimum required rank | No |
| Not active | Any | No |

## Points of judgement
An inactive club membership blocks opening either of these two tiers regardless of the rank the membership otherwise carries; a lower-ranked active membership likewise blocks opening either tier until the member's own club membership rank rises to meet that tier's minimum. The remaining four tiers of this product are not subject to this rank condition beyond any active membership already required to open them.
